tasks.acceptanceEvidence: barrier test shows all N lines intact; oversized record represented.
actions: Default the trace target to the shared repo log (repo-state.repoLogPath) so ALL runs/agents/worktrees append to ONE file that survives worktree closure; keep an explicit file override.

Serialize each entry to exactly ONE line and write it with exactly ONE write() per record (open 'a' + a single writeSync of a Buffer; verify bytesWritten === buffer length; a short write is a FAILURE, never retried in a way that can interleave). Never read-modify-write.

LOSS-LESS: never drop a record. If a record would exceed the size cap, TRUNCATE the long string fields after redaction with an explicit `…[truncated:<n>]` marker so the record is still represented. Cap the serialized line at a bounded size suitable for a single write (e.g. 512 KiB).

Document the atomicity contract honestly: cross-process append is atomic on LOCAL POSIX (O_APPEND single write); on non-local/Windows it is best-effort. The optional mkdir lock (stale-timeout) is a MITIGATION for oversized/non-atomic cases, never the proof.

Extend tests/trace-log.test.mjs: default target is the shared log; N>=16 children with a start barrier each append a distinguishable payload -> all N lines present and valid with no interleaving; an oversized record is still represented (truncated marker) with NO partial line; a line appended via a path resolved before worktree removal persists in the shared log; XDG_STATE_HOME isolated. Wire the test into test-suite-tooling.
tasks.title: One shared, lossless, concurrency-safe trace log

tasks.acceptanceEvidence: concurrent register/unregister loses nothing; migration once.
actions: Store entries as per-entry files under repo-state.repoStateDir()/registry.d/<sha256hex(normalized real path)>.json (FULL digest, never truncated). register = write a same-directory unique temp (pid+random) then rename (same fs; handle EXDEV by failing loudly); unregister = unlink tolerating ENOENT; list = readdir of *.json ONLY (ignore *.tmp/.migrated), parse, and QUARANTINE (skip + trace) any malformed file OR any file whose embedded path does not match the requested id. Keep the exported API list/register/unregister; expose registryDir and keep registryPath legacy-only or point it at the new dir.

One-time migration BEFORE any register/unregister: resolve the legacy `.agents/state/temp-registry.json` from the MAIN worktree (first entry of `git worktree list --porcelain`) unioned across worktrees, and migrate it exactly once behind an atomically-created sentinel (registry.d/.migrated via tmp+rename). Never delete the legacy file without a trace; never re-migrate (no resurrection of unregistered entries).

tests/temp-registry.test.mjs: duplicate register dedupes; unregister idempotent; malformed/quarantined skipped not fatal; migration runs once and does not resurrect; (a) N processes register N distinct paths -> all present; (b) N processes unregister already-registered distinct paths -> remainder only; (c) same-path register/unregister race -> no torn file. Isolate XDG_STATE_HOME. Wire tests into test-suite-tooling.
tasks.title: Lock-free, loss-free per-entry registry with one-time migration
